_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Murder Mystery#000.src: Have you made any progress? There was a smashed window in there, it might be a good place to start.
Murder Mystery#000.dst: ¿Has avanzado algo? Había una ventana rota ahí dentro; podría ser un buen punto de partida.

Murder Mystery#001.src: It looks like the victim's head was somehow detatched from his body...
Murder Mystery#001.dst: Parece que, de algún modo, la cabeza de la víctima fue separada del cuerpo…

Murder Mystery#002.src: The victim's book collection seems to be exclusively made up of dimestore romance novels.
Murder Mystery#002.dst: La colección de libros de la víctima parece estar compuesta exclusivamente por novelas románticas baratas.

Murder Mystery#003.src: This painting doesn't seem to have anything to do with the murder, but its a nice landscape of {p}.
Murder Mystery#003.dst: Este cuadro no parece tener nada que ver con el asesinato, pero es un bonito paisaje de {p}.

Murder Mystery#004.src: This half-finished letter seems to be asking for a loan to pay off some kind of debt...
Murder Mystery#004.dst: Esta carta a medio escribir parece pedir un préstamo para liquidar algún tipo de deuda…

Murder Mystery#005.src: It looks like the attacker managed to break in through the window.
Murder Mystery#005.dst: Parece que el atacante logró entrar por la ventana.

Murder Mystery#006.src: It's a letter addressed to someone called Rohem in House No. {~} in {p}.
Murder Mystery#006.dst: Es una carta dirigida a alguien llamado Rohem, en la casa n.º {~} de {p}.
Murder Mystery#006.speaker: Tattered Letter 󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿪 󐀂

Murder Mystery#007.src: If you can find it, it will show you the way to get into the sewers. I'm sorry, I would tell you more if I knew more. But good luck with your investigation.
Murder Mystery#007.dst: Si lo encuentra, le indicará cómo entrar en las alcantarillas. Lo siento, le diría más si supiera más. Pero suerte con su investigación, señor.
Murder Mystery#007.speaker:
Rohem
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Murder Mystery#008.src: Some of those gamblers had a symbol built into their homes, shaped like a snake. If you find it, it'll show you the way into the sewers. Good luck, officer.
Murder Mystery#008.dst: Algunos de esos jugadores tenían un símbolo incrustado en sus casas, con forma de serpiente. Si lo encuentras, te mostrará el camino a las cloacas. Buena suerte, agente.
Murder Mystery#008.speaker: Cinfras Citizen 󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿢 󐀂

Murder Mystery#009.src: The barkeeper takes the snake symbol and examines it for a moment before nodding and giving it back to you.
Murder Mystery#009.dst: El tabernero coge el símbolo de la serpiente y lo examina un momento antes de asentir y devolvértelo.
Murder Mystery#009.speaker:
Barkeeper
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Murder Mystery#010.src: The barkeeper gestures down to the open trapdoor.
Murder Mystery#010.dst: El tabernero señala hacia la trampilla abierta.

Murder Mystery#011.src: But the day he brought Eminar 'round, though, it got ugly fast. Kept borrowing Rohem's emeralds and losing, til neither of em had anythin' left.
Murder Mystery#011.dst: Pero el día que trajo a Eminar, la cosa se torció rápido. No paraba de pedirle esmeraldas a Rohem y perder, hasta que ninguno tuvo nada.
Murder Mystery#011.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#012.src: Now get out of 'ere; there's a back exit in the wall over there. Though, if ya ever fancy a game of 'jack, come back 'n we'll be happy to serve ya!
Murder Mystery#012.dst: Ahora largo de aquí; hay una salida trasera en esa pared. Aunque si algún día te apetece una partida de blackjack, ¡vuelve y te atenderemos encantados!
Murder Mystery#012.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#013.src: What are ya lingerin' around 'ere for? I've told ya all I know. Now either take a seat or get out.
Murder Mystery#013.dst: ¿Qué haces rondando por aquí? Ya te he contado todo lo que sé. Ahora, o te sientas o te vas.

Murder Mystery#014.src: Ya can then hit and get another card as many times as ya want, or stand and end ya turn. The aim is to get the value of your hand as close to {~} as possible!
Murder Mystery#014.dst: Puedes pedir carta tantas veces como quieras, o plantarte y acabar tu turno. ¡El objetivo es acercar tu mano lo más posible a {~}!
Murder Mystery#014.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#015.src: It seems like you better go have a chat with Rohem...
Murder Mystery#015.dst: Parece que será mejor que vayas a charlar con Rohem…

Murder Mystery#016.src: You should look around for clues that tie Rohem to the murder.
Murder Mystery#016.dst: Deberías buscar por los alrededores pistas que relacionen a Rohem con el asesinato.
Murder Mystery#016.speaker:
Rohem
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Murder Mystery#017.src: Get out of my house, officer, and don't you dare go rooting around in my property!
Murder Mystery#017.dst: ¡Sal de mi casa, agente, y no se te ocurra andar fisgoneando en mis cosas!
Murder Mystery#017.speaker:
Grook 󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿞 󐀂
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Murder Mystery#018.src: It's a dirty shovel - it must've been used recently to dig something up.
Murder Mystery#018.dst: Es una pala sucia: debe de haberse usado hace poco para desenterrar algo.

Murder Mystery#019.src: There's a trail of muddy footprints leading back into the house.
Murder Mystery#019.dst: Hay un rastro de huellas de barro que vuelve hacia la casa.

Murder Mystery#020.src: Whatever, you pale-faced walking cowlick. You're headed to {p} with a charge of first-class murder. Guards, take him away.
Murder Mystery#020.dst: Lo que tú digas, remolino andante de cara pálida. Te vas a la Penitenciaría de {p} acusado de asesinato en primer grado. Guardias, lleváoslo.
Murder Mystery#020.speaker:
Rohem
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Murder Mystery#021.src: Thank you for your help in catching the perpetrator!
Murder Mystery#021.dst: ¡Gracias por tu ayuda para atrapar al culpable!
Murder Mystery#021.speaker:
Detective Lorias
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Murder Mystery#022.src: Looks like the symbol has something carved in on the back...
Murder Mystery#022.dst: Parece que el símbolo tiene algo grabado por detrás...

Murder Mystery#023.dst: Habla con el detective Lorias en [-{~}, -{~}].

Murder Mystery#024.src: Stand back, human! This is a crime scene, under my authority. I cannot let you inside.
Murder Mystery#024.dst: ¡Atrás, humano! Esto es la escena de un crimen, bajo mi autoridad. No puedo dejarte entrar.
Murder Mystery#024.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#025.src: Although we are in need of some... assistance... and you are fairly experienced, are you not?
Murder Mystery#025.dst: Aunque nos vendría bien algo de... ayuda... y tú tienes bastante experiencia, ¿verdad?
Murder Mystery#025.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#026.src: Well, straight to the point... do you think I might be able to hire you as a private investigator?
Murder Mystery#026.dst: Bien, al grano... ¿crees que podría contratarte como investigador privado?
Murder Mystery#026.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#027.src: To put it bluntly, the owner of this house, Eminar, was murdered a few days ago, and what few leads we had have all gone cold.
Murder Mystery#027.dst: Sin rodeos: al dueño de esta casa, Eminar, lo asesinaron hace unos días, y las pocas pistas que teníamos se han enfriado.
Murder Mystery#027.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#028.src: This is acting outside protocol, of course... but if you manage to catch the killer, I'm sure I could pull some strings and pay you for your work!
Murder Mystery#028.dst: Esto va contra el protocolo, por supuesto... pero si logras atrapar al asesino, ¡seguro que puedo mover hilos y pagarte por tu trabajo!
Murder Mystery#028.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#029.src: I'll make sure no one stops you inside the crime scene. Head inside the house and see if you can find anything helpful.
Murder Mystery#029.dst: Me aseguraré de que nadie te detenga en la escena. Entra en la casa y mira si encuentras algo útil.
Murder Mystery#029.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#030.src: My soldiers and I will keep watch outside the house, and make sure you're not disturbed. Be careful in there!
Murder Mystery#030.dst: Mis soldados y yo vigilaremos fuera para que nadie te moleste. ¡Ten cuidado ahí dentro!
Murder Mystery#030.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#031.src: Investigate the crime scene at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] for clues.
Murder Mystery#031.dst: Investiga la escena del crimen en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] en busca de pistas.

Murder Mystery#032.src: Ah, a human! A refreshing sight these days. You've come to see me, I presume? What brings you here?
Murder Mystery#032.dst: ¡Ah, un humano! Qué refrescante hoy en día. Viene a verme, supongo. ¿Qué le trae por aquí?
Murder Mystery#032.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#033.src: An investigation!? Eminar? That's... that's absurd. I've done nothing wrong.
Murder Mystery#033.dst: ¿¡Una investigación!? ¿Eminar? Es... es absurdo. Yo no he hecho nada.
Murder Mystery#033.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#034.src: Still, the poor man. Eminar and I were good friends, you know. If it could help find his killer, I may have some information for you... strictly off-record, of course...
Murder Mystery#034.dst: Aun así, pobre hombre. Eminar y yo éramos buenos amigos, ¿sabe? Si sirve para hallar a su asesino, quizá tenga información para usted... extraoficial, por supuesto...
Murder Mystery#034.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#035.src: Well. You see, there's an underground gambling den hidden in the city's sewers. Only the elite can get in, and Eminar happened to be a frequent visitor.
Murder Mystery#035.dst: Verá. Hay un garito clandestino escondido en las alcantarillas de la ciudad. Solo entra la élite, y Eminar resultaba ser un cliente asiduo.
Murder Mystery#035.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#036.src: Once, he even brought me along with him.
Murder Mystery#036.dst: Una vez incluso me llevó con él.
Murder Mystery#036.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#037.src: Eminar, though, he often tried to cheat the other gamblers. I suppose it was only a matter of time before they had enough; most do not take cheating lightly.
Murder Mystery#037.dst: Solo que Eminar solía intentar engañar a los otros jugadores. Supongo que era cuestión de tiempo que se hartaran; pocos se toman bien las trampas.
Murder Mystery#037.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#038.src: Back to the point, many of them, including poor Eminar, had a symbol built into the sides of their homes, shaped like a snake. A proof of membership, you could say.
Murder Mystery#038.dst: Al grano: muchos de ellos, y el pobre Eminar también, tenían un símbolo empotrado en la pared de casa, con forma de serpiente. Una prueba de pertenencia, digamos.
Murder Mystery#038.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#040.src: Return to the victim's house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to find a snake symbol.
Murder Mystery#040.dst: Vuelve a la casa de la víctima en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] para buscar un símbolo de serpiente.

Murder Mystery#041.src: Find the gamblers in the {p} sewers.
Murder Mystery#041.dst: Encuentra a los jugadores en las alcantarillas de {p}.

Murder Mystery#042.src: How did ya find us down 'ere? I don't remember you... you're with the police, aren't ya? Here after Eminar, I suppose?
Murder Mystery#042.dst: ¿Cómo nos has encontrado aquí abajo? No te recuerdo... eres de la policía, ¿no? Vienes por Eminar, supongo.
Murder Mystery#042.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#043.src: Yeah, we've 'eard about what happened to him. Murders don't happen every day up there, ya know. And as it happened, I saw Eminar down here, not too long ago...
Murder Mystery#043.dst: Sí, ya oímos lo que le pasó. Ahí arriba no matan a nadie todos los días, ¿sabes? Y mira por dónde, vi a Eminar aquí abajo no hace mucho...
Murder Mystery#043.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#044.src: Well... as long as I get a guarantee I won't be shut down, I'll help ya. This is a very profitable place, as I'm sure ya might've guessed.
Murder Mystery#044.dst: Bueno... mientras me garantices que no me cierran, te ayudo. Esto da mucho dinero, como ya habrás supuesto.
Murder Mystery#044.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#045.src: He was brought down here by his friend one day. Rohem, it was. A fine customer, you understand. Never failed to pay his dues...
Murder Mystery#045.dst: Un día lo trajo aquí abajo su amigo. Rohem, se llamaba. Un cliente estupendo, ya me entiendes. Siempre pagaba sus deudas...
Murder Mystery#045.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#047.src: It was a good day for me, for obvious reasons, don'cha see! But Rohem was furious. Dead drunk, too, but what else is new!
Murder Mystery#047.dst: ¡Para mí fue un buen día, por motivos obvios, ya ves! Pero Rohem estaba furioso. Y borracho perdido, ¡como siempre!
Murder Mystery#047.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#048.src: Neither of 'em has been back since, though in Eminar's case, I can see why! And I hope that's enough for ya, 'cause that's all I got.
Murder Mystery#048.dst: Ninguno ha vuelto desde entonces, ¡aunque lo de Eminar se entiende! Espero que te baste, porque no tengo más.
Murder Mystery#048.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#050.src: Confront Rohem about the murder at house #{~} in {p}.
Murder Mystery#050.dst: Encara a Rohem por el asesinato en la casa #{~} de {p}.

Murder Mystery#051.src: Ah... you again! You're back. I see that. I must admit, I did not expect you to return... so soon...
Murder Mystery#051.dst: Ah... ¡usted otra vez! Ha vuelto. Ya lo veo. Confieso que no esperaba que volviera... tan pronto...
Murder Mystery#051.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#052.src: You really did find your way down there? Oh, that's... excellent... I hope the investigation is going well. Now if you'll just leave me be-
Murder Mystery#052.dst: ¿De verdad encontró el camino? Ah, eso es... excelente... Espero que la investigación vaya bien. Y ahora, si me deja en paz-
Murder Mystery#052.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#053.src: Valimare? Bah! Why would you trust anything he says? He's a criminal! A scam artist! I mean, I did direct you to him, but...
Murder Mystery#053.dst: ¿Valimare? ¡Bah! ¿Por qué iba a creerle nada? ¡Es un criminal! ¡Un estafador! Bueno, sí, yo le mandé con él, pero...
Murder Mystery#053.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#054.src: He- He's the one you should be arresting. Eminar was a danger to society, got what he deserved, the fool-
Murder Mystery#054.dst: A él... a él debería detener. Eminar era un peligro público, se llevó su merecido, el muy necio-
Murder Mystery#054.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#055.src: Wait! No! Don't turn me in! Can't you let me finish my drink in peace? Get out, get out, you can't prove anything!
Murder Mystery#055.dst: ¡Espere! ¡No! ¡No me entregue! ¿No puede dejarme acabar la copa? ¡Fuera, fuera, no puede probar nada!
Murder Mystery#055.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#056.src: Besides, have you ever heard of a little thing called evidence? You don't have any proof!
Murder Mystery#056.dst: Además, ¿ha oído hablar de algo llamado pruebas? ¡No tiene ninguna!
Murder Mystery#056.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#057.src: Now, officer, if you don't have a proper warrant, I expect you to vacate my property immediately!
Murder Mystery#057.dst: Y ahora, agente, si no tiene una orden en regla, ¡espero que abandone mi propiedad de inmediato!
Murder Mystery#057.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#058.src: Find the murder weapon around Rohem's house at house #{~} in {p}.
Murder Mystery#058.dst: Busca el arma homicida alrededor de la casa #{~} de Rohem en {p}.

Murder Mystery#059.src: Hi! I'm digging a hole in my garden, just like Mr. Rohem did last night!
Murder Mystery#059.dst: ¡Hola! ¡Cavo un hoyo en el jardín, como el señor Rohem anoche!
Murder Mystery#059.speaker: Child

Murder Mystery#060.src: For the last time officer, would you either show me a warrant or get out of my- what are you doing in my garden?!
Murder Mystery#060.dst: Por última vez, agente, o me enseña una orden o sale de mi- ¿¡qué hace en mi jardín!?
Murder Mystery#060.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#061.src: A... a hatchet? I don't know what you mean, I- I've never seen that before in my life!
Murder Mystery#061.dst: ¿Un... un hacha? No sé de qué me habla, ¡yo- jamás he visto eso en mi vida!
Murder Mystery#061.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#062.src: Gah! Curse you, human! I might be headed to jail, but I can send you straight to hell!
Murder Mystery#062.dst: ¡Agh! ¡Maldito humano! ¡Puede que yo vaya a la cárcel, pero a usted lo mando al infierno!
Murder Mystery#062.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#063.src: That's enough, Rohem! Stand down, or the guards will attack.
Murder Mystery#063.dst: ¡Basta, Rohem! Ríndete, o la guardia atacará.
Murder Mystery#063.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#064.src: Augh! Fine, you've got me. But mark my words, this won't be the last you hear of me, human!
Murder Mystery#064.dst: ¡Augh! Está bien, me ha cogido. Pero recuerde mis palabras: ¡no será la última vez que oiga de mí, humano!
Murder Mystery#064.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#066.src: As for you, human, please accept my immense gratitude. We probably wouldn't have caught that rat without you.
Murder Mystery#066.dst: En cuanto a ti, humano, acepta mi inmensa gratitud. Sin ti no habríamos cazado a esa rata.
Murder Mystery#066.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#067.src: On behalf of the city of {p}, please accept these emeralds as compensation for your services. You were a fine detective today!
Murder Mystery#067.dst: En nombre de la ciudad de {p}, acepta estas esmeraldas como pago por tus servicios. ¡Hoy has sido un gran detective!
Murder Mystery#067.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#068.src: Heya there! Fancy a quick game of blackjack?
Murder Mystery#068.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#070.src: Good stuff! Put ya money in the pot and I'll start the deal.
Murder Mystery#070.dst: ¡Estupendo! Pon tu dinero en el bote y reparto.
Murder Mystery#070.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#071.src: Not feelin' up to playin' right now? No worries, just drop by later!
Murder Mystery#071.dst: ¿Ahora no te apetece jugar? Tranquilo, ¡pásate luego!
Murder Mystery#071.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#072.src: Not right now? No worries - come back another time!
Murder Mystery#072.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#073.src: Ah, new to the game huh? No worries, lemme tell ya all about it!
Murder Mystery#073.dst: Ah, ¿nuevo en el juego? Tranquilo, ¡te lo explico todo!
Murder Mystery#073.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#074.src: The rules are simple! I deal two cards face up to ya both face down, and two cards to me, one face up and one face down.
Murder Mystery#074.dst: ¡Las reglas son simples! Te doy dos cartas boca abajo, y a mí otras dos: una boca arriba y otra boca abajo.
Murder Mystery#074.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#076.src: Number cards are worth what they say, all picture cards are worth {~}, and an ace can be worth either {~} or {~}, whichever works best for ya hand.
Murder Mystery#076.dst: Las cartas numeradas valen su número, las figuras valen {~}, y un as vale {~} u {~}, lo que mejor le venga a tu mano.
Murder Mystery#076.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#077.src: Go over {~} and that's it - you're bust! Stand with your current hand and it's my turn to hit or stand to try and beat your hand.
Murder Mystery#077.dst: Pasa de {~} y se acabó: ¡te pasas! Plántate con tu mano y me toca a mí pedir o plantarme para intentar ganarte.
Murder Mystery#077.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#078.src: And if ya get a blackjack - that's an ace and a picture card or a ten - ya automatically get double ya money back!
Murder Mystery#078.dst: Y si sacas un blackjack, o sea un as y una figura o un diez, ¡recuperas automáticamente el doble!
Murder Mystery#078.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#079.src: Sound fair enough? Alrighty, just right-click me again to play!
Murder Mystery#079.dst: ¿Te parece justo? ¡Venga, haz clic derecho otra vez para jugar!
Murder Mystery#079.speaker: Blackjack Dealer
